```java
package dev.metis.tools.canary;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.NoSuchFileException;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;

class CanaryTest {

  @TempDir Path root;

  @Test
  void aCanaryCollectsWhatItPlantsWithoutChangingTheOneItWasMadeFrom() {
    Canary bare = Canary.of("lint-length", "lint", "[FileLength]");
    Canary planted =
        bare.writing("a/B.java", "class B {}\n")
            .writing("a/C.java", "class C {}\n")
            .appending("build.gradle.kts", "tasks.register(\"checkCanary\")\n")
            .replacing("build.gradle.kts", "dependsOn(a, b)", "dependsOn(a)")
            .deleting("test-floor.json")
            .arguments("-Pmutate=a.B");
    assertThat(bare)
        .isEqualTo(
            new Canary(
                "lint-length",
                "lint",
                "[FileLength]",
                List.of(),
                Map.of(),
                Map.of(),
                List.of(),
                List.of()));
    assertThat(planted.writes())
        .containsExactly(
            Map.entry("a/B.java", "class B {}\n"), Map.entry("a/C.java", "class C {}\n"));
    assertThat(planted.appends())
        .containsExactly(Map.entry("build.gradle.kts", "tasks.register(\"checkCanary\")\n"));
    assertThat(planted.replacements())
        .containsExactly(
            new Canary.Replacement("build.gradle.kts", "dependsOn(a, b)", "dependsOn(a)"));
    assertThat(planted.deletes()).containsExactly("test-floor.json");
    assertThat(planted.args()).containsExactly("-Pmutate=a.B");
  }

  @Test
  void plantingWritesFilesInNewFoldersAppendsToFilesReplacesATextAndDeletesFiles()
      throws IOException {
    Files.writeString(root.resolve("build.gradle.kts"), "plugins {}\n");
    Files.writeString(root.resolve("a.kts"), "dependsOn(a, b)\ndependsOn(a, b)\n");
    Files.writeString(root.resolve("test-floor.json"), "{}\n");
    Files.writeString(root.resolve("Old.java"), "class Old {}\n");
    Canary.of("all-kinds", "lint", "x")
        .writing("a/b/New.java", "class New {}\n")
        .writing("Old.java", "class Replaced {}\n")
        .appending("build.gradle.kts", "tasks.register(\"checkCanary\")\n")
        .replacing("a.kts", "dependsOn(a, b)", "dependsOn(a)")
        .deleting("test-floor.json")
        .plant(root);
    assertThat(root.resolve("a.kts")).hasContent("dependsOn(a)\ndependsOn(a, b)");
    assertThat(root.resolve("a/b/New.java")).hasContent("class New {}");
    assertThat(root.resolve("Old.java")).hasContent("class Replaced {}");
    assertThat(root.resolve("build.gradle.kts"))
        .hasContent("plugins {}\ntasks.register(\"checkCanary\")");
    assertThat(root.resolve("test-floor.json")).doesNotExist();
  }

  @Test
  void appendingToOrDeletingAFileTheTreeLacksIsAnError() {
    assertThatThrownBy(() -> Canary.of("a", "lint", "x").appending("gone.txt", "x").plant(root))
        .isInstanceOf(NoSuchFileException.class);
    assertThatThrownBy(() -> Canary.of("d", "lint", "x").deleting("gone.txt").plant(root))
        .isInstanceOf(NoSuchFileException.class);
  }

  @Test
  void replacingATextTheFileLacksIsAnErrorSoACounterTestNeverPlantsNothing() throws IOException {
    Files.writeString(root.resolve("a.kts"), "dependsOn(a)\n");
    assertThatThrownBy(
            () -> Canary.of("r", "unit", "x").replacing("a.kts", "dependsOn(b)", "").plant(root))
        .isInstanceOf(IOException.class)
        .hasMessage("a.kts holds no dependsOn(b)");
  }
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.tools.canary;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import dev.metis.tools.Processes;
import dev.metis.tools.TestContext;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.nio.file.attribute.PosixFilePermissions;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;

class CanaryRunTest {

  private static final Canary LENGTH =
      Canary.of("lint-length", "lint", "[FileLength]")
          .writing("core/Long.java", "class Long {}\n")
          .arguments("-Pextra=1");
  private static final Processes.Result GREEN = new Processes.Result(0, "BUILD SUCCESSFUL\n");

  @TempDir Path root;

  private final List<List<String>> commands = new ArrayList<>();

  @BeforeEach
  void tree() throws IOException {
    Files.writeString(root.resolve("gradlew"), "#!/bin/sh\n");
    Files.setPosixFilePermissions(
        root.resolve("gradlew"), PosixFilePermissions.fromString("rwxr-xr-x"));
    Files.createDirectories(root.resolve("core"));
    Files.writeString(root.resolve("core/A.java"), "class A {}\n");
    Files.writeString(root.resolve("notes.txt"), "not listed\n");
  }

  private Path scratch() {
    return root.resolve("build/canary/lint-length");
  }

  // A check that answers the first run and the second one with the given results.
  private TestContext checks(Processes.Result before, Processes.Result after) {
    return new TestContext(root)
        .run(
            (dir, command) -> {
              assertThat(dir).isEqualTo(scratch());
              commands.add(command);
              boolean planted = Files.exists(dir.resolve("core/Long.java"));
              assertThat(planted).isEqualTo(commands.size() == 2);
              return planted ? after : before;
            });
  }

  private boolean run(TestContext test) throws IOException {
    return CanaryRun.run(test.context(), LENGTH, List.of("core/A.java", "gradlew"));
  }

  @Test
  void theFactsOfTheGreenRunAreGoneBeforeTheRunOnThePlantedDefect() throws IOException {
    TestContext test =
        new TestContext(root)
            .run(
                (dir, command) -> {
                  Path facts = dir.resolve("build/facts/lint.txt");
                  assertThat(facts).doesNotExist();
                  write(facts);
                  commands.add(command);
                  return commands.size() == 1 ? GREEN : new Processes.Result(1, "[FileLength]");
                });
    assertThat(run(test)).isTrue();
  }

  private static void write(Path facts) {
    try {
      Files.createDirectories(facts.getParent());
      Files.writeString(facts, "12 passed");
    } catch (IOException failed) {
      throw new AssertionError(failed);
    }
  }

  @Test
  void aCheckGreenOnTheCopyAndRedForThePlantedDefectCatchesItAndTheCopyIsRemoved()
      throws IOException {
    TestContext test = checks(GREEN, new Processes.Result(1, "Long.java:1: [FileLength]\n"));
    assertThat(run(test)).isTrue();
    assertThat(test.printed())
        .isEqualTo(
            """
            canary lint-length: running checkLint ...
            canary lint-length: checkLint went red because of the planted defect
            """);
    assertThat(commands)
        .allSatisfy(
            command ->
                assertThat(command)
                    .startsWith(scratch().resolve("gradlew").toString())
                    .endsWith("checkLint", "-Pextra=1"));
    assertThat(scratch()).doesNotExist();
    assertThat(root.resolve("build/canary/lint-length.log"))
        .hasContent("Long.java:1: [FileLength]");
    assertThat(root.resolve("core/Long.java")).doesNotExist();
  }

  @Test
  void theCopyHoldsTheListedFilesWithTheirModesAndNothingAnEarlierRunLeft() throws IOException {
    Files.createDirectories(scratch());
    Files.writeString(scratch().resolve("leftover.txt"), "from an earlier run\n");
    TestContext test =
        new TestContext(root)
            .run(
                (dir, command) -> {
                  assertThat(dir.resolve("core/A.java")).hasContent("class A {}");
                  assertThat(dir.resolve("gradlew")).isExecutable();
                  assertThat(dir.resolve("notes.txt")).doesNotExist();
                  assertThat(dir.resolve("leftover.txt")).doesNotExist();
                  return GREEN;
                });
    assertThat(run(test)).isFalse();
    assertThat(scratch()).isDirectory();
  }

  @Test
  void aCheckThatStaysGreenWithTheDefectIsBlindAndKeepsItsCopy() throws IOException {
    TestContext test = checks(GREEN, GREEN);
    assertThat(run(test)).isFalse();
    assertThat(test.printed())
        .endsWith(
            "canary lint-length: checkLint did NOT catch the planted defect (exit 0),"
                + " see build/canary/lint-length.log\n");
    assertThat(scratch().resolve("core/Long.java")).exists();
  }

  @Test
  void aCheckRedForAnotherReasonOrGreenWhilePrintingTheTextDoesNotCatchTheDefect()
      throws IOException {
    assertThat(run(checks(GREEN, new Processes.Result(1, "ENOENT\n")))).isFalse();
    commands.clear();
    TestContext loud = checks(GREEN, new Processes.Result(0, "[FileLength]\n"));
    assertThat(run(loud)).isFalse();
    assertThat(loud.printed()).contains("did NOT catch the planted defect (exit 0)");
  }

  @Test
  void aCheckAlreadyRedBeforePlantingFailsAtOnceAndPlantsNothing() throws IOException {
    Processes.Result red = new Processes.Result(3, "[FileLength] in another file\n");
    TestContext test = checks(red, GREEN);
    assertThat(run(test)).isFalse();
    assertThat(commands).hasSize(1);
    assertThat(test.printed())
        .endsWith(
            "canary lint-length: checkLint was already red before planting (exit 3),"
                + " see build/canary/lint-length.log\n");
    assertThat(scratch().resolve("core/Long.java")).doesNotExist();
    assertThat(root.resolve("build/canary/lint-length.log"))
        .hasContent("[FileLength] in another file");
  }
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.tools.mutation;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

class ScopeTest {

  private static final List<String> PROJECTS = List.of("core", "tools");
  private static final Set<String> SOURCES =
      Set.of(
          "tools/src/main/java/dev/metis/tools/verify/Verify.java",
          "tools/src/main/java/dev/metis/tools/Git.java",
          "core/src/main/java/dev/metis/core/CoreApplication.java",
          "tools/src/main/java/Root.java");

  private static Scope since(String... changed) {
    return Scope.since("origin/main", List.of(changed), PROJECTS, SOURCES::contains);
  }

  @Test
  void withoutABaseEveryClassOfEveryProjectIsMutated() {
    assertThat(Scope.full(PROJECTS))
        .isEqualTo(
            new Scope(
                "full",
                Map.of(
                    "core", List.of("dev.metis.core.*"), "tools", List.of("dev.metis.tools.*"))));
  }

  @Test
  void theClassesGivenGoToTheProjectWhosePackageTheyNameAndTheRestIsDropped() {
    assertThat(Scope.given("dev.metis.tools.canary.*,dev.metis.core.A*,other.B", PROJECTS))
        .isEqualTo(
            new Scope(
                "given dev.metis.tools.canary.*,dev.metis.core.A*,other.B",
                Map.of(
                    "core",
                    List.of("dev.metis.core.A*"),
                    "tools",
                    List.of("dev.metis.tools.canary.*"))));
  }

  @Test
  void aChangedSourceIsMutatedWithItsNestedClassesAndAChangedTestStandsForTheSourceBesideIt() {
    Scope scope =
        since(
            "tools/src/main/java/dev/metis/tools/Git.java",
            "tools/src/test/java/dev/metis/tools/verify/VerifyCommandTest.java",
            "tools/src/test/java/dev/metis/tools/GitTest.java",
            "core/README.md",
            "build.gradle.kts",
            "other/src/main/java/a/B.java",
            "other/src/test/java/a/BTest.java",
            "tools/src/test/java/RootTest.java",
            "core/src/main/java/dev/metis/core/CoreApplication.java");
    assertThat(scope)
        .isEqualTo(
            new Scope(
                "partial since origin/main: 4 classes",
                Map.of(
                    "core",
                    List.of("dev.metis.core.CoreApplication", "dev.metis.core.CoreApplication$*"),
                    "tools",
                    List.of(
                        "Root",
                        "Root$*",
                        "dev.metis.tools.Git",
                        "dev.metis.tools.Git$*",
                        "dev.metis.tools.verify.Verify",
                        "dev.metis.tools.verify.Verify$*"))));
  }

  @Test
  void aChangedTestThatStandsForNoSourceOrTheSharedTestsMutateWholeProjects() {
    assertThat(since("core/src/test/java/dev/metis/core/ProbesTest.java"))
        .isEqualTo(
            new Scope(
                "partial since origin/main: 0 classes, and every class of core",
                Map.of("core", List.of("dev.metis.core.*"), "tools", List.of())));
    assertThat(since("test-support/java/dev/metis/testsupport/LocalHostOnly.java").globs())
        .isEqualTo(
            Map.of("core", List.of("dev.metis.core.*"), "tools", List.of("dev.metis.tools.*")));
  }

  @Test
  void aChangeThatTouchesNoClassMutatesNothing() {
    assertThat(since("README.md"))
        .isEqualTo(
            new Scope(
                "partial since origin/main: 0 classes",
                Map.of("core", List.of(), "tools", List.of())));
  }
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.tools.mutation;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import dev.metis.tools.Facts;
import dev.metis.tools.Processes;
import dev.metis.tools.TestContext;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.List;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;

class MutationsTest {

  private static final String SCOPE = "build/mutation/scope.properties";
  private static final String TOOLS = "tools/build/reports/pitest/mutations.xml";
  private static final String CORE_RAN = "core/build/reports/pitest/ran";
  private static final String TOOLS_RAN = "tools/build/reports/pitest/ran";

  @TempDir Path root;

  private TestContext run(String command, String... args) throws IOException {
    TestContext test =
        new TestContext(root)
            .run(
                (dir, git) ->
                    switch (git.getLast()) {
                      case "origin/gone...HEAD" -> new Processes.Result(128, "fatal: bad revision");
                      case "origin/wide...HEAD" ->
                          new Processes.Result(
                              0, "tools/src/test/java/dev/metis/tools/BTest.java\0");
                      default ->
                          new Processes.Result(
                              0, "tools/src/test/java/dev/metis/tools/ATest.java\0");
                    });
    test.exit =
        command.equals("scope")
            ? Mutations.scope(test.context(), List.of(args))
            : Mutations.judge(test.context(), List.of(args));
    return test;
  }

  private void write(String path, String text) throws IOException {
    Files.createDirectories(root.resolve(path).getParent());
    Files.writeString(root.resolve(path), text);
  }

  private static String mutation(boolean detected, String status, String method, int line) {
    return """
        <mutation detected='%s' status='%s' numberOfTestsRun='1'><sourceFile>A.java</sourceFile>\
        <mutatedClass>dev.metis.tools.A</mutatedClass><mutatedMethod>%s</mutatedMethod>\
        <methodDescription>()I</methodDescription><lineNumber>%d</lineNumber>\
        <mutator>org.pitest.Math</mutator><description>replaced addition</description></mutation>
        """
        .formatted(detected, status, method, line);
  }

  @Test
  void theScopeIsWrittenForTheMutationTasksAndAReportOfAnEarlierRunIsRemoved() throws IOException {
    write(TOOLS, "<mutations/>");
    write(TOOLS_RAN, "PIT ran\n");
    TestContext full = run("scope", "core", "tools");
    assertThat(full.exit).isZero();
    assertThat(full.printed()).isEqualTo("mutation: full\n");
    assertThat(root.resolve(SCOPE))
        .hasContent("label=full\ncore=dev.metis.core.*\ntools=dev.metis.tools.*");
    assertThat(root.resolve(TOOLS)).doesNotExist();
    assertThat(root.resolve(TOOLS_RAN)).doesNotExist();
    run("scope", "--given", "dev.metis.tools.A*", "core", "tools");
    assertThat(root.resolve(SCOPE))
        .hasContent("label=given dev.metis.tools.A*\ncore=\ntools=dev.metis.tools.A*");
    write("tools/src/main/java/dev/metis/tools/A.java", "class A {}\n");
    run("scope", "--base", "origin/main", "core", "tools");
    assertThat(root.resolve(SCOPE))
        .hasContent(
            "label=partial since origin/main: 1 classes\ncore=\ntools=dev.metis.tools.A,dev.metis.tools.A$*");
    run("scope", "--base", "origin/wide", "core", "tools");
    assertThat(root.resolve(SCOPE))
        .hasContent(
            "label=partial since origin/wide: 0 classes, and every class of tools\ncore=\ntools=dev.metis.tools.*");
  }

  @Test
  void aBaseGitCannotDiffAgainstOrNoProjectStopsTheScope() throws IOException {
    TestContext gone = run("scope", "--base", "origin/gone", "core");
    assertThat(gone.exit).isEqualTo(1);
    assertThat(gone.printed())
        .isEqualTo("mutation: cannot list the changes since origin/gone: fatal: bad revision\n");
    assertThat(run("scope", "--given", "x").exit).isEqualTo(2);
    TestContext none = run("scope");
    assertThat(none.exit).isEqualTo(2);
    assertThat(none.printed())
        .isEqualTo("usage: mutation-scope [--given <globs> | --base <ref>] <project> ...\n");
  }

  @Test
  void everyMutantDetectedIsGreenAndTheFactsNameTheScopeAndEachProject() throws IOException {
    write(SCOPE, "label=full\ncore=dev.metis.core.*\ntools=dev.metis.tools.*\n");
    // The task of PIT leaves its trace, and no mutations.xml, for classes that hold no mutant.
    write(CORE_RAN, "PIT ran\n");
    write(TOOLS_RAN, "PIT ran\n");
    write(
        TOOLS,
        "<mutations>\n"
            + mutation(true, "KILLED", "a", 3)
            + mutation(true, "TIMED_OUT", "b", 4)
            + "</mutations>\n");
    TestContext test = run("judge", "core", "tools");
    assertThat(test.exit).isZero();
    String facts = "full: 2 mutants, 2 killed (core 0, tools 2)";
    assertThat(test.printed()).isEqualTo("mutation: " + facts + "\n");
    assertThat(Facts.read(root, "mutation")).hasValue(facts);
  }

  @Test
  void aMutantThatSurvivedOrThatNoTestRanIsRedAndNamedWhereItLives() throws IOException {
    write(SCOPE, "label=given dev.metis.tools.A*\ncore=\ntools=dev.metis.tools.A*\n");
    write(TOOLS_RAN, "PIT ran\n");
    write(
        TOOLS,
        "<mutations>\n"
            + mutation(false, "SURVIVED", "a", 3)
            + mutation(false, "NO_COVERAGE", "b", 9)
            + mutation(true, "KILLED", "c", 12)
            + "</mutations>\n");
    TestContext test = run("judge", "core", "tools");
    assertThat(test.exit).isEqualTo(1);
    assertThat(test.printed().lines())
        .containsExactly(
            "mutation: SURVIVED dev.metis.tools.A.a line 3: replaced addition",
            "mutation: NO_COVERAGE dev.metis.tools.A.b line 9: replaced addition",
            "mutation: given dev.metis.tools.A*: 3 mutants, 1 killed (tools 3)");
  }

  @Test
  void aProjectOfTheScopeThatPitLeftNoReportForIsRedRatherThanCountedAsNoMutant()
      throws IOException {
    write(SCOPE, "label=full\ncore=dev.metis.core.*\ntools=dev.metis.tools.*\n");
    write(TOOLS_RAN, "PIT ran\n");
    write(TOOLS, "<mutations>\n" + mutation(true, "KILLED", "a", 3) + "</mutations>\n");
    TestContext test = run("judge", "core", "tools");
    assertThat(test.exit).isEqualTo(1);
    assertThat(test.printed().lines())
        .containsExactly(
            "mutation: core: PIT did not run for the classes of the scope",
            "mutation: full: 1 mutants, 1 killed (core none, tools 1)");
  }

  @Test
  void aFullRunWithoutAMutantProvesNothingButAPartialOneThatTouchedNoClassIsGreen()
      throws IOException {
    write(SCOPE, "label=full\ntools=dev.metis.tools.*\n");
    write(TOOLS_RAN, "PIT ran\n");
    TestContext empty = run("judge", "tools");
    assertThat(empty.exit).isEqualTo(1);
    assertThat(empty.printed())
        .isEqualTo(
            "mutation: full: 0 mutants, 0 killed (tools 0): no mutant, so nothing was proven\n");
    write(SCOPE, "label=partial since origin/main: 0 classes\ntools=\n");
    TestContext partial = run("judge", "tools");
    assertThat(partial.exit).isZero();
    assertThat(partial.printed())
        .isEqualTo("mutation: partial since origin/main: 0 classes: 0 mutants, 0 killed\n");
  }

  @Test
  void aMissingScopeIsRedAndAMalformedReportIsRed() throws IOException {
    TestContext noScope = run("judge", "tools");
    assertThat(noScope.exit).isEqualTo(1);
    assertThat(noScope.printed())
        .isEqualTo("mutation: no scope in " + SCOPE + ": run the mutation scope first\n");
    write(SCOPE, "label=full\ntools=dev.metis.tools.*\n");
    write(TOOLS_RAN, "PIT ran\n");
    write(TOOLS, "<mutations");
    TestContext broken = run("judge", "tools");
    assertThat(broken.exit).isEqualTo(1);
    assertThat(broken.printed()).startsWith("mutation: mutations.xml is no XML: ");
    TestContext usage = run("judge");
    assertThat(usage.exit).isEqualTo(2);
    assertThat(usage.printed()).isEqualTo("usage: mutation <project> ...\n");
  }
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.tools;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.UncheckedIOException;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.security.MessageDigest;
import java.security.NoSuchAlgorithmException;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.HexFormat;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.TreeSet;
import java.util.function.Function;

/** What git says about a repository: the files it would commit, their stamp, the commit, a diff. */
public final class Git {

  /** The tree of a row whose files git could not list, which a full run of ./verify refuses. */
  public static final String UNKNOWN = "unknown (git could not list the files)";

  private static final List<String> LIST =
      List.of("ls-files", "-co", "--exclude-standard", "-z", "--", ".");
  private static final List<String> STATUS =
      List.of("--no-optional-locks", "status", "--porcelain", "--", ".");

  private final Path root;
  private final Function<List<String>, Processes.Result> git;

  /** A view of the repository at root, where git runs a git command given its arguments. */
  public Git(Path root, Function<List<String>, Processes.Result> git) {
    this.root = root;
    this.git = git;
  }

  /** The files git would commit that exist, in path order; empty when git cannot list them. */
  public Optional<List<String>> files() {
    return quietly(LIST)
        .map(
            listed ->
                new TreeSet<>(Arrays.asList(listed.output().split("\0")))
                    .stream().filter(path -> Files.isRegularFile(root.resolve(path))).toList());
  }

  /** A hash of the paths and bytes of the files git would commit, and the count of changes. */
  public String tree() {
    Optional<List<String>> files = files();
    Optional<Processes.Result> status = quietly(STATUS);
    if (files.isEmpty() || status.isEmpty()) {
      return UNKNOWN;
    }
    try {
      MessageDigest digest = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256");
      for (String file : files.get()) {
        digest.update((file + "\0").getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
        digest.update(Files.readAllBytes(root.resolve(file)));
        digest.update((byte) 0);
      }
      String hash = HexFormat.of().formatHex(digest.digest()).substring(0, 12);
      return hash + " (" + status.get().output().lines().count() + " uncommitted)";
    } catch (IOException | NoSuchAlgorithmException unreadable) {
      return UNKNOWN;
    }
  }

  /** The commit git stands on, or none before the first commit. */
  public String commit() {
    return quietly(List.of("rev-parse", "HEAD")).map(head -> head.output().strip()).orElse("none");
  }

  /** The paths that changed between the base and the commit git stands on. */
  public List<String> changedSince(String base) throws IOException {
    List<String> args = List.of("diff", "--name-only", "-z", "--relative", base + "...HEAD");
    Processes.Result diff = git.apply(args);
    if (diff.status() != 0) {
      String reason = diff.output().strip();
      throw new IOException("cannot list the changes since " + base + ": " + reason);
    }
    return Arrays.stream(diff.output().split("\0")).filter(path -> !path.isEmpty()).toList();
  }

  private Optional<Processes.Result> quietly(List<String> args) {
    try {
      return Optional.of(git.apply(args)).filter(result -> result.status() == 0);
    } catch (UncheckedIOException missing) {
      return Optional.empty();
    }
  }
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.tools.canary;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.nio.file.StandardOpenOption;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

/** A counter-test: a defect for a copy of the tree, and the text its check must go red with. */
public record Canary(
    String name,
    String check,
    String expect,
    List<String> args,
    Map<String, String> writes,
    Map<String, String> appends,
    List<Canary.Replacement> replacements,
    List<String> deletes) {

  /** A text of a file of the tree that the canary replaces with another. */
  public record Replacement(String path, String text, String with) {}

  /** A canary that plants nothing yet. */
  public static Canary of(String name, String check, String expect) {
    return new Canary(name, check, expect, List.of(), Map.of(), Map.of(), List.of(), List.of());
  }

  /** The same canary, which also writes the file, in place of the one the tree holds. */
  public Canary writing(String path, String text) {
    return new Canary(
        name, check, expect, args, with(writes, path, text), appends, replacements, deletes);
  }

  /** The same canary, which also adds the text to the end of a file of the tree. */
  public Canary appending(String path, String text) {
    return new Canary(
        name, check, expect, args, writes, with(appends, path, text), replacements, deletes);
  }

  /** The same canary, which also replaces the first place of a text in a file of the tree. */
  public Canary replacing(String path, String text, String with) {
    List<Replacement> more = new ArrayList<>(replacements);
    more.add(new Replacement(path, text, with));
    return new Canary(name, check, expect, args, writes, appends, List.copyOf(more), deletes);
  }

  /** The same canary, which also deletes a file of the tree. */
  public Canary deleting(String path) {
    return new Canary(
        name, check, expect, args, writes, appends, replacements, with(deletes, path));
  }

  /** The same canary, whose check runs with further arguments, to keep a slow check small. */
  public Canary arguments(String... more) {
    return new Canary(
        name, check, expect, with(args, more), writes, appends, replacements, deletes);
  }

  /** Plants the defect in the copy of the tree at root. */
  void plant(Path root) throws IOException {
    for (Map.Entry<String, String> file : writes().entrySet()) {
      Path path = root.resolve(file.getKey());
      Files.createDirectories(path.getParent());
      Files.writeString(path, file.getValue());
    }
    for (Map.Entry<String, String> file : appends().entrySet()) {
      Files.writeString(root.resolve(file.getKey()), file.getValue(), StandardOpenOption.APPEND);
    }
    for (Replacement swap : replacements()) {
      Path path = root.resolve(swap.path());
      String text = Files.readString(path);
      int at = text.indexOf(swap.text());
      if (at < 0) {
        throw new IOException(swap.path() + " holds no " + swap.text());
      }
      Files.writeString(
          path, text.substring(0, at) + swap.with() + text.substring(at + swap.text().length()));
    }
    for (String path : deletes()) {
      Files.delete(root.resolve(path));
    }
  }

  private static Map<String, String> with(Map<String, String> map, String key, String value) {
    Map<String, String> copy = new LinkedHashMap<>(map);
    copy.put(key, value);
    return Collections.unmodifiableMap(copy);
  }

  private static List<String> with(List<String> list, String... more) {
    List<String> copy = new ArrayList<>(list);
    copy.addAll(List.of(more));
    return List.copyOf(copy);
  }
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.tools.mutation;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.TreeMap;
import java.util.TreeSet;
import java.util.function.Predicate;
import java.util.regex.Matcher;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;
import java.util.stream.Stream;

/** What a mutation run mutates per project, and its name, so a partial run never reads as full. */
record Scope(String label, Map<String, List<String>> globs) {

  private static final String MAIN = "/src/main/java/";
  private static final String TEST = "/src/test/java/";
  private static final Pattern WORD = Pattern.compile("[A-Z][a-z0-9]*");

  /** Every class of every project. */
  static Scope full(List<String> projects) {
    Map<String, List<String>> globs = new TreeMap<>();
    projects.forEach(project -> globs.put(project, List.of(packageOf(project) + "*")));
    return new Scope("full", globs);
  }

  /** The globs given, each in the project whose package it names. */
  static Scope given(String list, List<String> projects) {
    List<String> asked = Arrays.asList(list.split(","));
    Map<String, List<String>> globs = new TreeMap<>();
    for (String project : projects) {
      globs.put(
          project, asked.stream().filter(glob -> glob.startsWith(packageOf(project))).toList());
    }
    return new Scope("given " + list, globs);
  }

  /** The classes changed paths touch; a test with no source of its own brings its whole project. */
  static Scope since(
      String base, List<String> changed, List<String> projects, Predicate<String> exists) {
    Map<String, Set<String>> classes = new TreeMap<>();
    Set<String> whole = new TreeSet<>();
    for (String path : changed) {
      String project = path.substring(0, Math.max(0, path.indexOf('/')));
      if (path.startsWith("test-support/")) {
        // ponytail: a shared test mutates every class; map tests to classes by coverage to lift it.
        whole.addAll(projects);
      } else if (path.startsWith(project + MAIN)) {
        classesOf(classes, project).add(classOf(path.substring((project + MAIN).length())));
      } else if (projects.contains(project) && path.startsWith(project + TEST)) {
        sourceOf(project, path.substring((project + TEST).length()), exists)
            .ifPresentOrElse(classesOf(classes, project)::add, () -> whole.add(project));
      }
    }
    Map<String, List<String>> globs = new TreeMap<>();
    int count = 0;
    for (String project : projects) {
      count += classesOf(classes, project).size();
      globs.put(
          project,
          whole.contains(project)
              ? List.of(packageOf(project) + "*")
              : classesOf(classes, project).stream()
                  .flatMap(name -> Stream.of(name, name + "$*"))
                  .toList());
    }
    String every = whole.isEmpty() ? "" : ", and every class of " + String.join(" and ", whole);
    return new Scope("partial since " + base + ": " + count + " classes" + every, globs);
  }

  private static Set<String> classesOf(Map<String, Set<String>> classes, String project) {
    return classes.computeIfAbsent(project, key -> new TreeSet<>());
  }

  private static String packageOf(String project) {
    return "dev.metis." + project + ".";
  }

  private static String classOf(String file) {
    return file.substring(0, file.length() - ".java".length()).replace('/', '.');
  }

  // A test named FooBarTest stands for FooBar, else for Foo: the longest name with a source wins.
  private static Optional<String> sourceOf(String project, String file, Predicate<String> exists) {
    int slash = file.lastIndexOf('/') + 1;
    String name = file.substring(slash).replaceAll("(Test)?\\.java$", "");
    List<String> names = new ArrayList<>();
    for (Matcher word = WORD.matcher(name); word.find(); ) {
      names.addFirst(file.substring(0, slash) + name.substring(0, word.end()));
    }
    return names.stream()
        .filter(candidate -> exists.test(project + MAIN + candidate + ".java"))
        .findFirst()
        .map(candidate -> candidate.replace('/', '.'));
  }
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.tools.mutation;

import dev.metis.tools.Context;
import dev.metis.tools.Facts;
import dev.metis.tools.Xml;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.PrintStream;
import java.io.Reader;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Properties;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;
import org.w3c.dom.Element;
import org.w3c.dom.NodeList;

/** The scope of a PIT run, written before it, and the judge that wants every mutant detected. */
public final class Mutations {

  private static final String SCOPE = "build/mutation/scope.properties";
  private static final String REPORTS = "/build/reports/pitest/";

  private Mutations() {}

  /** Writes the scope of the run: the classes given, the classes changed since a base, or all. */
  public static int scope(Context context, List<String> args) throws IOException {
    PrintStream out = context.out();
    boolean option = !args.isEmpty() && args.getFirst().startsWith("--");
    List<String> projects = args.subList(Math.min(args.size(), option ? 2 : 0), args.size());
    if (projects.isEmpty()) {
      out.println("usage: mutation-scope [--given <globs> | --base <ref>] <project> ...");
      return 2;
    }
    Path root = context.root();
    Scope scope;
    if (!option) {
      scope = Scope.full(projects);
    } else if (args.getFirst().equals("--given")) {
      scope = Scope.given(args.get(1), projects);
    } else {
      try {
        List<String> changed = context.git().changedSince(args.get(1));
        scope =
            Scope.since(
                args.get(1), changed, projects, path -> Files.isRegularFile(root.resolve(path)));
      } catch (IOException noDiff) {
        out.println("mutation: " + noDiff.getMessage());
        return 1;
      }
    }
    StringBuilder text = new StringBuilder("label=" + scope.label() + "\n");
    for (String project : projects) {
      text.append(project)
          .append('=')
          .append(String.join(",", scope.globs().get(project)))
          .append('\n');
      // A report an earlier run left behind must not speak for this run.
      Files.deleteIfExists(root.resolve(project + REPORTS + "mutations.xml"));
      Files.deleteIfExists(root.resolve(project + REPORTS + "ran"));
    }
    Files.createDirectories(root.resolve(SCOPE).getParent());
    Files.writeString(root.resolve(SCOPE), text);
    out.println("mutation: " + scope.label());
    return 0;
  }

  /** Judges the report PIT left in each project of the scope on its own, and leaves the facts. */
  public static int judge(Context context, List<String> args) throws IOException {
    PrintStream out = context.out();
    if (args.isEmpty()) {
      out.println("usage: mutation <project> ...");
      return 2;
    }
    Path root = context.root();
    if (!Files.exists(root.resolve(SCOPE))) {
      out.println("mutation: no scope in " + SCOPE + ": run the mutation scope first");
      return 1;
    }
    Properties scope = new Properties();
    try (Reader reader = Files.newBufferedReader(root.resolve(SCOPE))) {
      scope.load(reader);
    }
    List<Report> reports = new ArrayList<>();
    for (String project : args) {
      if (!scope.getProperty(project, "").isEmpty()) {
        try {
          reports.add(reportOf(root, project));
        } catch (IOException malformed) {
          out.println("mutation: " + malformed.getMessage());
          return 1;
        }
      }
    }
    return verdict(root, out, scope.getProperty("label", ""), reports);
  }

  /** The mutants of one project of the scope, or that PIT left it no report. */
  private record Report(String project, int mutants, List<String> live, boolean missing) {}

  // PIT writes mutations.xml only for classes that hold a mutant, and its task leaves a trace.
  private static Report reportOf(Path root, String project) throws IOException {
    Path folder = root.resolve(project + REPORTS);
    if (!Files.exists(folder.resolve("ran"))) {
      return new Report(project, 0, List.of(), true);
    }
    Path xml = folder.resolve("mutations.xml");
    if (!Files.exists(xml)) {
      return new Report(project, 0, List.of(), false);
    }
    NodeList found = Xml.read(xml).getElementsByTagName("mutation");
    return new Report(project, found.getLength(), liveIn(found), false);
  }

  private static int verdict(Path root, PrintStream out, String label, List<Report> reports)
      throws IOException {
    int mutants = reports.stream().mapToInt(Report::mutants).sum();
    List<String> live = reports.stream().flatMap(report -> report.live().stream()).toList();
    List<String> missing =
        reports.stream()
            .filter(Report::missing)
            .map(
                report ->
                    "mutation: "
                        + report.project()
                        + ": PIT did not run for the classes of the scope")
            .toList();
    String each =
        reports.stream()
            .map(report -> report.project() + " " + (report.missing() ? "none" : report.mutants()))
            .collect(Collectors.joining(", "));
    // A full run without a mutant means the wiring broke, since the tool alone has hundreds.
    boolean empty = mutants == 0 && !label.startsWith("partial");
    String facts =
        "%s: %d mutants, %d killed%s%s"
            .formatted(
                label,
                mutants,
                mutants - live.size(),
                each.isEmpty() ? "" : " (" + each + ")",
                empty ? ": no mutant, so nothing was proven" : "");
    missing.forEach(out::println);
    live.forEach(out::println);
    out.println("mutation: " + facts);
    Facts.write(root, "mutation", facts);
    return live.isEmpty() && missing.isEmpty() && !empty ? 0 : 1;
  }

  private static List<String> liveIn(NodeList mutations) {
    List<String> live = new ArrayList<>();
    for (int at = 0; at < mutations.getLength(); at++) {
      Element mutation = (Element) mutations.item(at);
      if (!mutation.getAttribute("detected").equals("true")) {
        live.add(
            "mutation: %s %s.%s line %s: %s"
                .formatted(
                    mutation.getAttribute("status"),
                    text(mutation, "mutatedClass"),
                    text(mutation, "mutatedMethod"),
                    text(mutation, "lineNumber"),
                    text(mutation, "description")));
      }
    }
    return live;
  }

  private static String text(Element mutation, String tag) {
    return mutation.getElementsByTagName(tag).item(0).getTextContent();
  }
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.tools.canary;

import java.util.List;

/** The counter-tests of the mutation check. */
final class MutationCanaries {

  // The core and one package of the tool: the core holds no mutant of its own, the package does.
  private static final String SMALL = "-Pmutate=dev.metis.core.*,dev.metis.tools.canary.*";

  static final List<Canary> ALL =
      List.of(
          // A test of the core that asserts nothing of the result, so PIT is seen to reach the
          // core.
          Canary.of("mutation-weak-test", "mutation", "SURVIVED dev.metis.core.CanaryWeak")
              .writing(
                  Canaries.CORE + "CanaryWeak.java",
                  """
                  package dev.metis.core;

                  final class CanaryWeak {
                    private CanaryWeak() {}

                    static int twice(int number) {
                      return number * 2;
                    }
                  }
                  """)
              .writing(
                  "core/src/test/java/dev/metis/core/CanaryWeakTest.java",
                  """
                  package dev.metis.core;

                  import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

                  import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

                  class CanaryWeakTest {
                    @Test
                    void runs() {
                      assertThat(CanaryWeak.twice(2)).isInstanceOf(Integer.class);
                    }
                  }
                  """)
              .arguments(SMALL),
          // A project of the scope whose PIT never ran, which must not count as one without
          // mutants.
          Canary.of("mutation-no-report", "mutation", "core: PIT did not run")
              .appending("core/build.gradle.kts", "\ntasks.named(\"pitest\") { enabled = false }\n")
              .arguments(SMALL));

  private MutationCanaries() {}
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.tools.canary;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.stream.Stream;

/** Every counter-test, in the order ./canary all runs them. */
public final class Canaries {

  /** The folder of the core's own classes, where most canaries plant a class. */
  static final String CORE = "core/src/main/java/dev/metis/core/";

  /** Every counter-test, one list per check. */
  public static final List<Canary> ALL =
      Stream.of(
              FormatCanaries.ALL,
              CompileCanaries.ALL,
              LintCanaries.ALL,
              LanguageCanaries.ALL,
              ArchitectureCanaries.ALL,
              DeadcodeCanaries.ALL,
              ToolingCanaries.ALL,
              UnitCanaries.ALL,
              CoverageCanaries.ALL,
              MutationCanaries.ALL)
          .flatMap(List::stream)
          .toList();

  private Canaries() {}
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.tools;

import dev.metis.tools.canary.CanaryRun;
import dev.metis.tools.coverage.Coverage;
import dev.metis.tools.deadcode.Deadcode;
import dev.metis.tools.language.Language;
import dev.metis.tools.lint.Marks;
import dev.metis.tools.mutation.Mutations;
import dev.metis.tools.tests.TestReports;
import dev.metis.tools.verify.Verify;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable;

/** The commands of the tool of the checks. */
public final class Cli {

  private static final Map<String, Command> COMMANDS =
      Map.of(
          "verify", Verify::command,
          "canary", CanaryRun::command,
          "language", Language::command,
          "marks", Marks::command,
          "tests", TestReports::command,
          "deadcode", Deadcode::command,
          "coverage", Coverage::command,
          "mutation-scope", Mutations::scope,
          "mutation", Mutations::judge);

  private static final String USAGE =
      """
      usage: verify [--only <check>[,<check>]] [--fast] [--append]
             canary <name>|all
             language [<path> ...]
             marks
             tests <check> <folder of test reports> ...
             deadcode <file of entry points> <project> ...
             coverage <JaCoCo XML report> ...
             mutation-scope [--given <globs> | --base <ref>] <project> ...
             mutation <project> ...""";

  private Cli() {}

  /** Runs the command the arguments name and returns its exit code. */
  public static int run(Context context, List<String> args) throws IOException {
    @Nullable Command command = args.isEmpty() ? null : COMMANDS.get(args.getFirst());
    if (command == null) {
      context.out().println(USAGE);
      return 2;
    }
    return command.run(context, args.subList(1, args.size()));
  }
}
```

```kotlin
import net.ltgt.gradle.errorprone.errorprone
import java.util.Properties
import org.gradle.api.tasks.testing.logging.TestExceptionFormat

plugins {
    java
    jacoco
    checkstyle
    id("net.ltgt.errorprone")
    id("info.solidsoft.pitest")
}

val catalog = the<VersionCatalogsExtension>().named("libs")

// Half the cores, so that tests and mutation testing never take the whole machine.
val half = (Runtime.getRuntime().availableProcessors() / 2).coerceAtLeast(1)

java {
    toolchain {
        languageVersion = JavaLanguageVersion.of(25)
        vendor = JvmVendorSpec.AMAZON
    }
}

dependencyLocking {
    lockAllConfigurations()
    lockMode = LockMode.STRICT
}

// The tests of both projects share one guard against calls that leave the machine.
sourceSets.named("test") {
    java.srcDir(rootProject.layout.projectDirectory.dir("test-support/java"))
    resources.srcDir(rootProject.layout.projectDirectory.dir("test-support/resources"))
}

dependencies {
    implementation(platform(catalog.findLibrary("spring-boot-bom").get()))
    implementation(platform(catalog.findLibrary("jackson-bom").get()))
    constraints {
        for (tomcat in listOf("tomcat-embed-core", "tomcat-embed-el", "tomcat-embed-websocket")) {
            implementation(catalog.findLibrary(tomcat).get())
        }
    }
    compileOnly("org.jspecify:jspecify")
    testCompileOnly("org.jspecify:jspecify")
    errorprone(catalog.findLibrary("errorprone-core").get())
    errorprone(catalog.findLibrary("nullaway").get())
    testImplementation(platform(catalog.findLibrary("junit-bom").get()))
    testImplementation("org.junit.jupiter:junit-jupiter-api")
    testImplementation("org.assertj:assertj-core")
    testImplementation(catalog.findLibrary("archunit-junit6-api").get())
    testRuntimeOnly("org.junit.jupiter:junit-jupiter-engine")
    testRuntimeOnly(catalog.findLibrary("archunit-junit6-engine").get())
    testRuntimeOnly("org.junit.platform:junit-platform-launcher")
}

tasks.withType<JavaCompile>().configureEach {
    options.compilerArgs.addAll(listOf("-Xlint:all", "-Werror"))
    options.errorprone {
        error("UnusedVariable", "UnusedMethod", "UnusedNestedClass", "NullAway")
        option("NullAway:OnlyNullMarked", "true")
    }
}

// A new seed on every run, printed, so that a test that depends on another one shows, and the run can be repeated.
val testSeed = providers.gradleProperty("testSeed").getOrElse(System.nanoTime().toString())

tasks.withType<Test>().configureEach {
    useJUnitPlatform()
    maxParallelForks = half
    // Every check runs its tests anew and no old report stays; coverage pays by running them again.
    dependsOn("clean${name.replaceFirstChar(Char::uppercase)}")
    systemProperty("junit.jupiter.testclass.order.default", "org.junit.jupiter.api.ClassOrderer\$Random")
    systemProperty("junit.jupiter.testmethod.order.default", "org.junit.jupiter.api.MethodOrderer\$Random")
    systemProperty("junit.jupiter.execution.order.random.seed", testSeed)
    testLogging {
        exceptionFormat = TestExceptionFormat.FULL
    }
    doFirst {
        logger.lifecycle("Test order seed $testSeed: repeat it with -PtestSeed=$testSeed")
    }
}

// The architecture rules and the test of the settings run as test tasks of their own, for their checks.
tasks.test {
    useJUnitPlatform {
        excludeTags("architecture", "deadcode")
    }
}

tasks.register<Test>("architectureTest") {
    description = "Runs the architecture rules."
    testClassesDirs = sourceSets.test.get().output.classesDirs
    classpath = sourceSets.test.get().runtimeClasspath
    useJUnitPlatform {
        includeTags("architecture")
    }
}

jacoco {
    toolVersion = catalog.findVersion("jacoco").get().requiredVersion
}

// The classes no test can run in the test process, each with its reason in the list.
val excluded =
    rootProject.file("config/coverage-exclusions.txt").readLines()
        .map { it.trim() }
        .filter { it.isNotEmpty() && !it.startsWith("#") }
        .map { it.substringBefore(":") }

tasks.jacocoTestReport {
    // A report an earlier run left behind must not speak for a run whose report task did not run.
    dependsOn("cleanJacocoTestReport", tasks.test)
    classDirectories.setFrom(
        sourceSets.main.get().output.classesDirs.asFileTree.matching {
            exclude(excluded.map { it.replace('.', '/') + ".class" })
        },
    )
    reports {
        xml.required = true
    }
}

checkstyle {
    toolVersion = catalog.findVersion("checkstyle").get().requiredVersion
    configDirectory = rootProject.layout.projectDirectory.dir("config/checkstyle")
}

// The classes to mutate come from the scope the tool writes before each run, so CI can mutate a change only.
val scope = rootProject.layout.buildDirectory.file("mutation/scope.properties")

fun scoped(): Set<String> {
    val read = Properties()
    scope.get().asFile.reader().use { read.load(it) }
    return read.getProperty(project.name, "").split(",").filter { it.isNotBlank() }.toSet()
}

pitest {
    pitestVersion = catalog.findVersion("pitest").get().requiredVersion
    junit5PluginVersion = catalog.findVersion("pitest-junit5").get().requiredVersion
    targetClasses = provider { scoped() }
    targetTests = setOf("dev.metis.${project.name}.*")
    excludedClasses = excluded.toSet()
    mutators = setOf("STRONGER")
    threads = half
    outputFormats = setOf("XML", "HTML")
    timestampedReports = false
    failWhenNoMutations = false
    excludedGroups = setOf("architecture", "deadcode")
}

tasks.named("pitest") {
    dependsOn(":tools:mutationScope")
    onlyIf("the scope holds classes of this project") { scoped().isNotEmpty() }
    // PIT writes no report for classes without a mutant, so the run leaves a trace for its judge.
    val ran = layout.buildDirectory.file("reports/pitest/ran")
    doLast {
        ran.get().asFile.writeText("PIT ran\n")
    }
    // A check runs PIT every time, as it runs its tests.
    outputs.upToDateWhen { false }
    outputs.cacheIf { false }
}
```

`tools/build.gradle.kts`:

```kotlin
plugins {
    id("metis.java-conventions")
    application
}

application {
    mainClass = "dev.metis.tools.Main"
}

dependencies {
    implementation(libs.archunit)
    implementation("tools.jackson.core:jackson-core")
    implementation("tools.jackson.core:jackson-databind")
}

// A command of the tool, run from the repository root, for a check of the root build to depend on.
fun tool(name: String, vararg arguments: String) =
    tasks.register<JavaExec>(name) {
        classpath = sourceSets.main.get().runtimeClasspath
        mainClass = application.mainClass
        workingDir = rootDir
        args(*arguments)
    }

tool("language", "language")
tool("marks", "marks")
// The walk resolves the types the classes of both projects extend, so it runs on their classpaths.
evaluationDependsOn(":core")
tool("deadcode", "deadcode", "config/entry-points.txt", "core", "tools").configure {
    val core = project(":core").the<SourceSetContainer>()
    classpath += core["test"].runtimeClasspath + sourceSets.test.get().runtimeClasspath
    dependsOn(":core:testClasses", tasks.testClasses)
}
// The judges of the test tasks, which run after the tests even when a test failed.
tool("judgeArchitecture", "tests", "architecture", "core/build/test-results/architectureTest", "tools/build/test-results/architectureTest")
    .configure { mustRunAfter(":core:architectureTest", tasks.named("architectureTest")) }
tool("judgeDeadcode", "tests", "deadcode", "core/build/test-results/deadcodeTest")
    .configure { mustRunAfter(":core:deadcodeTest") }
tool(
    "judgeCoverage", "coverage", "core/build/reports/jacoco/test/jacocoTestReport.xml",
    "tools/build/reports/jacoco/test/jacocoTestReport.xml",
).configure { mustRunAfter(":core:jacocoTestReport", tasks.jacocoTestReport) }
// What PIT mutates: the classes of -Pmutate, else the classes changed since MUTATION_BASE, else all.
tool("mutationScope", "mutation-scope").configure {
    val given = providers.gradleProperty("mutate").map { listOf("--given", it) }
    val base = providers.environmentVariable("MUTATION_BASE").filter { it.isNotBlank() }.map { listOf("--base", it) }
    argumentProviders.add(CommandLineArgumentProvider { given.orElse(base).getOrElse(listOf()) + listOf("core", "tools") })
}
tool("judgeMutation", "mutation", "core", "tools").configure { mustRunAfter(":core:pitest", tasks.pitest) }
tool("judgeTooling", "tests", "tooling", "tools/build/test-results/test").configure { mustRunAfter(tasks.test) }
tool("judgeUnit", "tests", "unit", "core/build/test-results/test").configure { mustRunAfter(":core:test") }

// ./verify and ./canary start the tool with the Java and the classpath this task writes, and the tool
// learns from it the check tasks Gradle has in every project, however a build file declares them.
val launcher = tasks.register("launcher") {
    val executable = javaToolchains.launcherFor(java.toolchain).map { it.executablePath.asFile.path }
    val classpath = sourceSets.main.map { it.runtimeClasspath }
    val checks = rootProject.allprojects.flatMap { project ->
        val prefix = if (project == rootProject) "" else project.path + ":"
        project.tasks.names.filter { it.matches(Regex("check[A-Z]\\w*")) }.map { prefix + it }
    }
    val folder = layout.buildDirectory.dir("launcher")
    inputs.files(classpath)
    inputs.property("java", executable)
    inputs.property("checks", checks)
    outputs.dir(folder)
    doLast {
        folder.get().file("java").asFile.writeText(executable.get() + "\n")
        folder.get().file("args").asFile.writeText("-cp\n\"" + classpath.get().asPath + "\"\n")
        folder.get().file("checks").asFile.writeText(checks.joinToString("") { "$it\n" })
    }
}

// The tests of the counter-tests read the list of checks the launcher writes.
tasks.named("testClasses") { dependsOn(launcher) }
```

`build.gradle.kts`:

```kotlin
plugins {
    alias(libs.plugins.spotless)
}

dependencyLocking {
    lockAllConfigurations()
}

spotless {
    java {
        target("core/src/**/*.java", "tools/src/**/*.java", "test-support/**/*.java")
        googleJavaFormat(libs.versions.google.java.format.get())
        removeUnusedImports()
    }
    format("misc") {
        target(
            "**/*.kts", "**/*.md", "**/*.yml", "**/*.yaml", "**/*.toml", "**/*.properties",
            "**/*.json", "**/*.xml", "**/*.txt", "**/Dockerfile", "**/.gitignore", ".dockerignore",
            "verify", "canary",
        )
        targetExclude("**/build/**", "**/.gradle/**", "**/.kotlin/**", "gradle/verification-metadata.xml")
        trimTrailingWhitespace()
        endWithNewline()
    }
}

// The checks of ./verify, which runs them in the order of the list of the tool, Checks.ORDER.

tasks.register("checkFormat") {
    description = "Every source file is formatted."
    dependsOn("spotlessCheck")
}

tasks.register("checkCompile") {
    description = "The code compiles with every warning an error, no bug pattern and no null where none is allowed."
    dependsOn(":core:compileJava", ":core:compileTestJava", ":tools:compileJava", ":tools:compileTestJava")
}

tasks.register("checkLint") {
    description = "No method above a complexity of 10, no file above 300 lines, a reason on every mark."
    dependsOn(
        ":core:checkstyleMain", ":core:checkstyleTest", ":tools:checkstyleMain", ":tools:checkstyleTest",
        ":tools:marks",
    )
}

tasks.register("checkLanguage") {
    description = "English only, and no comment that cites a plan, a ruling, a task, a date or a line of a file."
    dependsOn(":tools:language")
}

tasks.register("checkArchitecture") {
    description = "The architecture rules of both projects hold."
    dependsOn(":core:architectureTest", ":tools:architectureTest", ":tools:judgeArchitecture")
}

tasks.register("checkDeadcode") {
    description = "Nothing unused: code, test helpers, dependencies and settings."
    dependsOn(
        ":core:projectHealth", ":tools:projectHealth", "bundledDeclared", ":tools:deadcode",
        ":core:deadcodeTest", ":tools:judgeDeadcode",
    )
}

tasks.register("checkTooling") {
    description = "The tests of the tool pass, and every check has a counter-test."
    dependsOn(":tools:test", ":tools:judgeTooling")
}

tasks.register("checkUnit") {
    description = "The tests of the core that need no container pass, none skipped, as many as the floor."
    dependsOn(":core:test", ":tools:judgeUnit")
}

tasks.register("checkCoverage") {
    description = "Every line and every branch of the core and the tool runs in a test."
    dependsOn(":core:jacocoTestReport", ":tools:jacocoTestReport", ":tools:judgeCoverage")
}

tasks.register("checkMutation") {
    description = "Every mutant PIT makes of the core and the tool is killed by a test."
    dependsOn(":core:pitest", ":tools:pitest", ":tools:judgeMutation")
}

// A check whose judge did not run would pass on the exit of its tasks alone, so a check that owes
// facts fails without them; ./verify and ./canary clear the facts before each run of a check.
val factFree = setOf("checkFormat", "checkCompile", "checkDeps", "checkSecrets")
tasks.matching { it.name.matches(Regex("check[A-Z]\\w*")) && it.name !in factFree }.configureEach {
    val check = name.removePrefix("check").replaceFirstChar(Char::lowercase)
    val facts = layout.buildDirectory.file("facts/$check.txt")
    doLast {
        if (!facts.get().asFile.exists()) {
            throw GradleException("$name: its judge left no facts in build/facts/$check.txt")
        }
    }
}

// A starter stands for the libraries of it that the code uses, named one by one, which the plugin
// would otherwise ask to declare; a library a bundle names is never reported unused, so
// bundledDeclared refuses a project that declares one of them itself.
val starters =
    mapOf(
        "org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-starter-webmvc" to listOf(
            "org.springframework.boot:spring-boot",
            "org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-autoconfigure",
            "org.springframework:spring-context",
        ),
        "org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-starter-webmvc-test" to listOf(
            "org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-resttestclient",
            "org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-test",
            "org.springframework:spring-beans",
            "org.springframework:spring-core",
            "org.springframework:spring-test",
            "org.springframework:spring-web",
        ),
    )

configure<com.autonomousapps.DependencyAnalysisExtension> {
    structure {
        starters.forEach { (starter, libraries) ->
            bundle(starter.substringAfter(':')) {
                primary(starter)
                libraries.forEach { includeDependency(it) }
            }
        }
    }
    issues {
        all {
            onAny {
                severity("fail")
            }
        }
    }
}

val bundled = tasks.register("bundledDeclared") {
    description = "No project declares a library that a bundle names."
}

gradle.projectsEvaluated {
    val members = starters.values.flatten().toSet()
    val declared =
        subprojects.flatMap { project ->
            project.configurations.flatMap { configuration ->
                configuration.dependencies
                    .filter { "${it.group}:${it.name}" in members }
                    .map { "${it.group}:${it.name} in ${project.path} ${configuration.name}" }
            }
        }
    bundled.configure {
        doLast {
            if (declared.isNotEmpty()) {
                throw GradleException("a bundle names what a project declares, which it would never report: $declared")
            }
        }
    }
}
```

### Task 15: The deps check and the secrets check

`checkDeps`: Trivy 0.75.0 over the tree, which reads the lock files of every configuration of both projects and of the build, finds no known vulnerability; the licence report plugin 3.1.4 with SPDX names finds every library of the core's runtime classpath under a licence of `config/allowed-licenses.json`; `resolveLocked` resolves every configuration of both projects against the lock files and the checksums, so a stale lock or checksum fails. `checkSecrets`: gitleaks 8.30.1 over the tree, read by a relative path, with `.git`, the record `reports/` and the folders Gradle writes allowed, each by its exact place, as `.gitignore` places them, so a package named `build` is scanned. The scanners run as images pinned by digest, with the tree mounted read-only; Trivy keeps its database in the volume `metis-trivy-cache`.

**Files:**

- Create: `config/allowed-licenses.json`
- Create: `.gitleaks.toml`
- Create: `tools/src/main/java/dev/metis/tools/canary/DepsCanaries.java`
- Create: `tools/src/main/java/dev/metis/tools/canary/SecretsCanaries.java`
- Modify: `build.gradle.kts`
- Modify: `build-logic/src/main/kotlin/metis.java-conventions.gradle.kts`
- Modify: `core/build.gradle.kts`
- Modify: `tools/src/main/java/dev/metis/tools/canary/Canaries.java`
- Generated by a command of this task: `core/gradle.lockfile`, `tools/gradle.lockfile`, `gradle.lockfile`, `gradle/verification-metadata.xml`

**Interfaces:**

- Consumes: the catalog of Task 1 (the image digests); the counter-tests of Task 7; `CanariesTest` (Task 10).
- Produces: the Gradle tasks `depsVulnerabilities`, `secretsScan`, `:core:checkLicense` and `resolveLocked` (in both projects), the root tasks `checkDeps` and `checkSecrets`, the files `config/allowed-licenses.json` and `.gitleaks.toml`, and the counter-tests deps-vulnerability, deps-lock, deps-checksum, deps-licence, secrets-private-key and secrets-nested-build.

- [ ] **Step 1: Register the two checks**

`CanariesTest` is the failing test here: a check without a counter-test fails it.

`build.gradle.kts`:

```kotlin
plugins {
    alias(libs.plugins.spotless)
}

dependencyLocking {
    lockAllConfigurations()
}

spotless {
    java {
        target("core/src/**/*.java", "tools/src/**/*.java", "test-support/**/*.java")
        googleJavaFormat(libs.versions.google.java.format.get())
        removeUnusedImports()
    }
    format("misc") {
        target(
            "**/*.kts", "**/*.md", "**/*.yml", "**/*.yaml", "**/*.toml", "**/*.properties",
            "**/*.json", "**/*.xml", "**/*.txt", "**/Dockerfile", "**/.gitignore", ".dockerignore",
            "verify", "canary",
        )
        targetExclude("**/build/**", "**/.gradle/**", "**/.kotlin/**", "gradle/verification-metadata.xml")
        trimTrailingWhitespace()
        endWithNewline()
    }
}

// A scanner that is no Gradle plugin, run as its pinned image in the tree, which it reads only.
fun scanner(name: String, image: Provider<String>, options: List<String>, vararg arguments: String) =
    tasks.register<Exec>(name) {
        val tree = rootDir.absolutePath
        commandLine(
            listOf("docker", "run", "--rm", "--volume", "$tree:/work:ro", "--workdir", "/work") +
                options + listOf(image.get()) + arguments,
        )
    }

// Trivy keeps its database in a volume of its own, so a scan downloads it once a day at most.
val trivy = listOf("--volume", "metis-trivy-cache:/root/.cache")

scanner(
    "depsVulnerabilities", libs.versions.image.trivy, trivy,
    "fs", "--scanners", "vuln", "--exit-code", "1", "--quiet",
    "--skip-dirs", "/work/build", "--skip-dirs", "/work/**/build", "--skip-dirs", "/work/.gradle", "/work",
)

// A relative folder, so the paths the allow-list of .gitleaks.toml matches start at the root.
scanner(
    "secretsScan", libs.versions.image.gitleaks, listOf(),
    "dir", ".", "--no-banner", "--redact", "--verbose", "--config", ".gitleaks.toml",
)

// The checks of ./verify, which runs them in the order of the list of the tool, Checks.ORDER.

tasks.register("checkFormat") {
    description = "Every source file is formatted."
    dependsOn("spotlessCheck")
}

tasks.register("checkCompile") {
    description = "The code compiles with every warning an error, no bug pattern and no null where none is allowed."
    dependsOn(":core:compileJava", ":core:compileTestJava", ":tools:compileJava", ":tools:compileTestJava")
}

tasks.register("checkLint") {
    description = "No method above a complexity of 10, no file above 300 lines, a reason on every mark."
    dependsOn(
        ":core:checkstyleMain", ":core:checkstyleTest", ":tools:checkstyleMain", ":tools:checkstyleTest",
        ":tools:marks",
    )
}

tasks.register("checkLanguage") {
    description = "English only, and no comment that cites a plan, a ruling, a task, a date or a line of a file."
    dependsOn(":tools:language")
}

tasks.register("checkArchitecture") {
    description = "The architecture rules of both projects hold."
    dependsOn(":core:architectureTest", ":tools:architectureTest", ":tools:judgeArchitecture")
}

tasks.register("checkDeadcode") {
    description = "Nothing unused: code, test helpers, dependencies and settings."
    dependsOn(
        ":core:projectHealth", ":tools:projectHealth", "bundledDeclared", ":tools:deadcode",
        ":core:deadcodeTest", ":tools:judgeDeadcode",
    )
}

tasks.register("checkTooling") {
    description = "The tests of the tool pass, and every check has a counter-test."
    dependsOn(":tools:test", ":tools:judgeTooling")
}

tasks.register("checkUnit") {
    description = "The tests of the core that need no container pass, none skipped, as many as the floor."
    dependsOn(":core:test", ":tools:judgeUnit")
}

tasks.register("checkCoverage") {
    description = "Every line and every branch of the core and the tool runs in a test."
    dependsOn(":core:jacocoTestReport", ":tools:jacocoTestReport", ":tools:judgeCoverage")
}

tasks.register("checkMutation") {
    description = "Every mutant PIT makes of the core and the tool is killed by a test."
    dependsOn(":core:pitest", ":tools:pitest", ":tools:judgeMutation")
}

tasks.register("checkDeps") {
    description = "No known vulnerability, only allowed licences, and current lock files and checksums."
    dependsOn("depsVulnerabilities", ":core:checkLicense", ":core:resolveLocked", ":tools:resolveLocked")
}

tasks.register("checkSecrets") {
    description = "No secret in the tree."
    dependsOn("secretsScan")
}

// A check whose judge did not run would pass on the exit of its tasks alone, so a check that owes
// facts fails without them; ./verify and ./canary clear the facts before each run of a check.
val factFree = setOf("checkFormat", "checkCompile", "checkDeps", "checkSecrets")
tasks.matching { it.name.matches(Regex("check[A-Z]\\w*")) && it.name !in factFree }.configureEach {
    val check = name.removePrefix("check").replaceFirstChar(Char::lowercase)
    val facts = layout.buildDirectory.file("facts/$check.txt")
    doLast {
        if (!facts.get().asFile.exists()) {
            throw GradleException("$name: its judge left no facts in build/facts/$check.txt")
        }
    }
}

// A starter stands for the libraries of it that the code uses, named one by one, which the plugin
// would otherwise ask to declare; a library a bundle names is never reported unused, so
// bundledDeclared refuses a project that declares one of them itself.
val starters =
    mapOf(
        "org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-starter-webmvc" to listOf(
            "org.springframework.boot:spring-boot",
            "org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-autoconfigure",
            "org.springframework:spring-context",
        ),
        "org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-starter-webmvc-test" to listOf(
            "org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-resttestclient",
            "org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-test",
            "org.springframework:spring-beans",
            "org.springframework:spring-core",
            "org.springframework:spring-test",
            "org.springframework:spring-web",
        ),
    )

configure<com.autonomousapps.DependencyAnalysisExtension> {
    structure {
        starters.forEach { (starter, libraries) ->
            bundle(starter.substringAfter(':')) {
                primary(starter)
                libraries.forEach { includeDependency(it) }
            }
        }
    }
    issues {
        all {
            onAny {
                severity("fail")
            }
        }
    }
}

val bundled = tasks.register("bundledDeclared") {
    description = "No project declares a library that a bundle names."
}

gradle.projectsEvaluated {
    val members = starters.values.flatten().toSet()
    val declared =
        subprojects.flatMap { project ->
            project.configurations.flatMap { configuration ->
                configuration.dependencies
                    .filter { "${it.group}:${it.name}" in members }
                    .map { "${it.group}:${it.name} in ${project.path} ${configuration.name}" }
            }
        }
    bundled.configure {
        doLast {
            if (declared.isNotEmpty()) {
                throw GradleException("a bundle names what a project declares, which it would never report: $declared")
            }
        }
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Write the scans, the lists and the counter-tests**

`build-logic/src/main/kotlin/metis.java-conventions.gradle.kts`:

```kotlin
import net.ltgt.gradle.errorprone.errorprone
import java.util.Properties
import org.gradle.api.tasks.testing.logging.TestExceptionFormat

plugins {
    java
    jacoco
    checkstyle
    id("net.ltgt.errorprone")
    id("info.solidsoft.pitest")
}

val catalog = the<VersionCatalogsExtension>().named("libs")

// Half the cores, so that tests and mutation testing never take the whole machine.
val half = (Runtime.getRuntime().availableProcessors() / 2).coerceAtLeast(1)

java {
    toolchain {
        languageVersion = JavaLanguageVersion.of(25)
        vendor = JvmVendorSpec.AMAZON
    }
}

dependencyLocking {
    lockAllConfigurations()
    lockMode = LockMode.STRICT
}

// Resolving every configuration fails when a lock file or the checksums are not current.
tasks.register("resolveLocked") {
    description = "Resolves every configuration against the lock file and the checksums."
    val resolvable = configurations.filter { it.isCanBeResolved }.map { it.incoming.files }
    doLast {
        resolvable.forEach { it.files }
    }
}

// The tests of both projects share one guard against calls that leave the machine.
sourceSets.named("test") {
    java.srcDir(rootProject.layout.projectDirectory.dir("test-support/java"))
    resources.srcDir(rootProject.layout.projectDirectory.dir("test-support/resources"))
}

dependencies {
    implementation(platform(catalog.findLibrary("spring-boot-bom").get()))
    implementation(platform(catalog.findLibrary("jackson-bom").get()))
    constraints {
        for (tomcat in listOf("tomcat-embed-core", "tomcat-embed-el", "tomcat-embed-websocket")) {
            implementation(catalog.findLibrary(tomcat).get())
        }
    }
    compileOnly("org.jspecify:jspecify")
    testCompileOnly("org.jspecify:jspecify")
    errorprone(catalog.findLibrary("errorprone-core").get())
    errorprone(catalog.findLibrary("nullaway").get())
    testImplementation(platform(catalog.findLibrary("junit-bom").get()))
    testImplementation("org.junit.jupiter:junit-jupiter-api")
    testImplementation("org.assertj:assertj-core")
    testImplementation(catalog.findLibrary("archunit-junit6-api").get())
    testRuntimeOnly("org.junit.jupiter:junit-jupiter-engine")
    testRuntimeOnly(catalog.findLibrary("archunit-junit6-engine").get())
    testRuntimeOnly("org.junit.platform:junit-platform-launcher")
}

tasks.withType<JavaCompile>().configureEach {
    options.compilerArgs.addAll(listOf("-Xlint:all", "-Werror"))
    options.errorprone {
        error("UnusedVariable", "UnusedMethod", "UnusedNestedClass", "NullAway")
        option("NullAway:OnlyNullMarked", "true")
    }
}

// A new seed on every run, printed, so that a test that depends on another one shows, and the run can be repeated.
val testSeed = providers.gradleProperty("testSeed").getOrElse(System.nanoTime().toString())

tasks.withType<Test>().configureEach {
    useJUnitPlatform()
    maxParallelForks = half
    // Every check runs its tests anew and no old report stays; coverage pays by running them again.
    dependsOn("clean${name.replaceFirstChar(Char::uppercase)}")
    systemProperty("junit.jupiter.testclass.order.default", "org.junit.jupiter.api.ClassOrderer\$Random")
    systemProperty("junit.jupiter.testmethod.order.default", "org.junit.jupiter.api.MethodOrderer\$Random")
    systemProperty("junit.jupiter.execution.order.random.seed", testSeed)
    testLogging {
        exceptionFormat = TestExceptionFormat.FULL
    }
    doFirst {
        logger.lifecycle("Test order seed $testSeed: repeat it with -PtestSeed=$testSeed")
    }
}

// The architecture rules and the test of the settings run as test tasks of their own, for their checks.
tasks.test {
    useJUnitPlatform {
        excludeTags("architecture", "deadcode")
    }
}

tasks.register<Test>("architectureTest") {
    description = "Runs the architecture rules."
    testClassesDirs = sourceSets.test.get().output.classesDirs
    classpath = sourceSets.test.get().runtimeClasspath
    useJUnitPlatform {
        includeTags("architecture")
    }
}

jacoco {
    toolVersion = catalog.findVersion("jacoco").get().requiredVersion
}

// The classes no test can run in the test process, each with its reason in the list.
val excluded =
    rootProject.file("config/coverage-exclusions.txt").readLines()
        .map { it.trim() }
        .filter { it.isNotEmpty() && !it.startsWith("#") }
        .map { it.substringBefore(":") }

tasks.jacocoTestReport {
    // A report an earlier run left behind must not speak for a run whose report task did not run.
    dependsOn("cleanJacocoTestReport", tasks.test)
    classDirectories.setFrom(
        sourceSets.main.get().output.classesDirs.asFileTree.matching {
            exclude(excluded.map { it.replace('.', '/') + ".class" })
        },
    )
    reports {
        xml.required = true
    }
}

checkstyle {
    toolVersion = catalog.findVersion("checkstyle").get().requiredVersion
    configDirectory = rootProject.layout.projectDirectory.dir("config/checkstyle")
}

// The classes to mutate come from the scope the tool writes before each run, so CI can mutate a change only.
val scope = rootProject.layout.buildDirectory.file("mutation/scope.properties")

fun scoped(): Set<String> {
    val read = Properties()
    scope.get().asFile.reader().use { read.load(it) }
    return read.getProperty(project.name, "").split(",").filter { it.isNotBlank() }.toSet()
}

pitest {
    pitestVersion = catalog.findVersion("pitest").get().requiredVersion
    junit5PluginVersion = catalog.findVersion("pitest-junit5").get().requiredVersion
    targetClasses = provider { scoped() }
    targetTests = setOf("dev.metis.${project.name}.*")
    excludedClasses = excluded.toSet()
    mutators = setOf("STRONGER")
    threads = half
    outputFormats = setOf("XML", "HTML")
    timestampedReports = false
    failWhenNoMutations = false
    excludedGroups = setOf("architecture", "deadcode")
}

tasks.named("pitest") {
    dependsOn(":tools:mutationScope")
    onlyIf("the scope holds classes of this project") { scoped().isNotEmpty() }
    // PIT writes no report for classes without a mutant, so the run leaves a trace for its judge.
    val ran = layout.buildDirectory.file("reports/pitest/ran")
    doLast {
        ran.get().asFile.writeText("PIT ran\n")
    }
    // A check runs PIT every time, as it runs its tests.
    outputs.upToDateWhen { false }
    outputs.cacheIf { false }
}
```

```toml
# The rules gitleaks ships with, over the tree. What a build or a run writes is no source: each
# folder by its exact place, as .gitignore places it, so a package named build is scanned.
[extend]
useDefault = true

[allowlist]
paths = [
  '''^\.git/''',
  '''^reports/''',
  '''^build/''',
  '''^[^/]+/build/''',
  '''^(build-logic/)?\.gradle/''',
  '''^(build-logic/)?\.kotlin/''',
]
```
